label: GO step late in the episode after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), and only late in the episode: zero activity before ep_trial ~55, rate climbs steadily from 1.5% (trials 60-69) to 12% (90-99). Within that, 96% of activation mass follows an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward == 0, observed at D1); after a rewarded trial it is nearly silent. Strongest activations follow common-unrewarded trials; firing is also tied to low model value (<7.1 holds ~98% of mass), which likely reflects the same late-episode / no-reward conditions. Predicate (GO, ep_trial >= 70, prev_reward == 0) gets dev F1 0.61, mass recall 0.95: it covers nearly all the large activations, while the misses are weak activations at trials 55-70 or after rewarded trials. Precision is only ~0.5 because many late unrewarded GO steps stay silent. Adding prev_common == 1 raised precision but cut recall, so it was left out. Uses only observed variables. Magnitude grows with episode trial, so the feature probably acts as an episode-time / end-of-episode signal gated by the absence of reward.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S2 u, a1 S2 u, ?) and trial before (GO: a2 S1 u, a2 S2 u, a1 S1 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=7.
